decision.statistic: r = close(last RTH minute, pre-split session) / open(first RTH minute, effective session)
decision.FAIL_AMBIGUOUS: r falls outside both bands on either name, or the two names disagree on regime
decision.FAIL_PARAMETER_INERT: adjusted=true and adjusted=false return identical response digests — the parameter does not control anything and the regime is whatever it is
decision.UNRESOLVED: any required session is missing, or the split fact could not be independently confirmed
decision.note: the bands are wide enough to absorb a normal overnight move and narrow enough that 4x and 1x cannot both satisfy one of them

v and n for every minute from 09:25 to 10:00 ET
presence or absence of a bar stamped 16:00
